d.title: Made in Abyss Movie 1: Tabidachi no Yoake
d.jp: 劇場版総集編【前編】メイドインアビス 旅立ちの夜明け
syn: Made in Abyss Movie 1: Journey's Dawn
d.synopsis: The movie is a compilation of episodes 1-8 of the 2017 television series with new scenes added for the introduction. It covers the period from when Riko descends into the Abyss with her robot companion Reg, reaching the second layer where they meet the White Whistle Ozen who reveals information about Riko's mother.
